scope: Segment 134 field-level rules and fixed-length serialization

rules.title: Segment 134 uses NO Field Separators — fixed-length/positional, identical wire-format pattern to Segment 131
Segment 134 maximum length is 19 alphanumeric characters (01-19/a-z/A-Z)
rules.note: Field-length arithmetic (3+4+1+1+10=19) exactly reconciles with the stated maximum, consistent with there being no separators.

rules.title: Segment Type is fixed value 134, Segment Length is 4 digits
rules.note: PROVISIONAL: Segment 134 is not among the seven segments independently confirmed (via Segment 120's cross-reference) to require a 4-digit Segment Length, yet its own field table lists Segment Length as 4 characters. Flag this as an apparent addition to that family pending SME confirmation (SEG134-SME-001).

rules.title: Settlement Type (Element 198) is required, 1 character, valid values D (Dual message), S (Single message), X (Non-traditional Signature Debit — availability must be confirmed with First Data Project/Relationship Manager)
rules.note: PROVISIONAL: value X's availability is explicitly conditional on a business relationship configuration, not a pure technical rule. Pending SME confirmation (SEG134-SME-002) on which merchants/configurations have Signature Debit enabled.

rules.title: Signature Required (Element 199) is required, 1 character, valid values T (required), F (not required), Space (device software logic determines)
Receipt Card Description (Element 200) is required, 10 characters, left-justified and space-filled (e.g., 'STAR      ')
